title: Grateful Dead Live at Des Moines State Fairgrounds on 1973-05-13
lineage: MSR>R>?>C>DAT>WAV>SHN except for 4th disc/end of second set which is from previously circulated SHN set.

ai_review.summary: Epic 1973 outdoor show with monster jams (The Other One, Eyes, Playin' In The Band) captured on a decent‑quality soundboard despite noticeable hiss.
ai_review.review: Fans rave that this three‑set Des Moines fairground concert is one of the finest early‑’73 performances – rain, a double rainbow and long, spacey jams make it unforgettable.  The SBD source is a bit louder and hissier than other transfers, with a Jerry‑centric mix, but remains listenable enough to enjoy the stellar music.

ai_rating.rationale: Average star rating ~4.3 across 19 reviews; overwhelming praise for the performance outweighs modest recording complaints, yielding a strong overall score.

recording_quality.technical_notes: Noticeable tape hiss and a slightly Jerry‑centric mix; occasional noise‑reduction artifacts but overall clear and listenable for a 1973 SBD.

show_quality.setlist_flow: Three‑set outdoor extravaganza with rain turning to sunshine; a powerful first set, an extended second set featuring long jams (The Other One > Eyes), and a tight encore. The show flows naturally despite one noted track ordering issue (Casey Jones).

band_member_comments.Jerry: Garcia’s noodling opens the massive Other One jam; his tone is prominent in the mix, often described as ‘up in the mix’ and a highlight of the performance.
band_member_comments.Phil: Phil’s bass is praised for cello‑like sounds during the jams, especially on The Other One and Eyes.
band_member_comments.Keys: Keith’s piano on Eyes is likened to McCoy Tyner’s style; keyboards add depth to the second‑set improvisations.
